concerns.text: T006 instructs 'a mixed-effects logistic regression (binomial GLM with the same random-effects structure)' — statsmodels.GLM cannot fit random intercepts, and MixedLM does not support binomial responses. As written the task is not implementable with the pinned dependency (statsmodels==0.14.2). Specify an executable method (e.g., conditional logistic / GEE with exchangeable correlation, or BinomialBayesMixedGLM) and reconcile the output fields with the anova_accuracy schema block (F, df_between, df_within), which a logistic model does not naturally produce.

T007 computes correlations for both source- and human-reference variants (4 metrics × 2 references × 3 outcomes = 24 tests) but applies Bonferroni at α = 0.05/12, and its verification demands each metric-outcome combination 'appear exactly once' while the schema's metric enum has no reference-variant field. The task as specified cannot satisfy its own verification; pick one reference variant (or extend the schema) and set the correction denominator to the actual number of tests.

T002 reads 'data/raw_snippets.jsonl (after the validation pass producing data/validated_snippets.jsonl)' and its verification references validated_snippets.jsonl, but no task produces that file — T001 writes valid records directly to raw_snippets.jsonl. The parenthetical implies a step with no owning task; either T001 must emit validated_snippets.jsonl as a separate artifact or T002 must consume raw_snippets.jsonl.

T003a requires 'data/consent_form.pdf loads without error', but no task produces consent_form.pdf and it is not listed among inputs. The check is unexecutable until the file's producer (or its status as a pre-existing project input) is stated.

T005 specifies statsmodels.stats.power.FTestAnovaPower while plan.md Phase 6 specifies FTestPower — different classes with different interfaces. The implementer cannot satisfy both; align on one (FTestAnovaPower is the appropriate choice for a 3-group ANOVA).

The US-3 independent test requires the synthetic N=30 check to verify 'power ≥ 0.80', but T006's pytest only asserts p < 0.05. Add the power assertion to the synthetic fixture test so the stated verification is fully executable.
SC-006 requires completeness to be 'logged in dataset_preparation.log', but T001 produces no such log. Add the log artifact to T001's deliverables (or note the deviation) so the SC is checkable.
